name: Diamond DA40 Diamond Star
summary: Four-seat composite low-wing single with a T-tail, popular with flight schools and airline training academies.

wings: Long, slender composite low wing with glider-like proportions
engines: Single engine in a slim composite cowl
Three-blade prop on the diesel NG; two- or three-blade on petrol versions
fuselage: Large forward-hinged bubble canopy over the front seats plus a rear passenger door
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel pants
Slim tail boom tapering from the cabin

tellTales: Slender low wing with a T-tail and fixed gear
Large bubble canopy over the front seats
Long, thin tail boom behind the cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA20 is a two-seater with a shorter cabin and no rear windows; the DA40 has a longer four-seat cabin with rear side windows.
The Cirrus has a conventional low tail and side doors; the DA40 has a T-tail and a bubble canopy.
The DA42 has two engines on the wings; the DA40 has one in the nose.
